question: Bangladesh shares its border with which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__ Meghalaya.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Meghalaya shares a border with Bangladesh.
 
• Assam, West Bengal, Mizoram, Meghalaya, and Tripura are five Indian states that border Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://www.drishtiias.com/images/uploads/1570434960_image5.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**__ India's boundary with Bangladesh__

 
• India and Bangladesh share 4096.7 km. of border, which is the longest land boundary that India shares with any of its neighbours.
 
• It is the fifth-longest land border in the world, including 262 km in Assam, 856 km in Tripura, 318 km in Mizoram, 443 km in Meghalaya, and 2,217 km in West Bengal.
 
• Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand do not share a border with Bangladesh.
